newsitem.title: USA: Man planned mom's murder on Mother's Day -police.
newsitem.headline: Man planned mom's murder on Mother's Day -police.

text.p: A man was arrested on Mother's Day and charged with plotting to have his mother killed so he could collect on her life insurance policy, police said Tuesday.

Charles Wooton, 27, was arrested on Sunday, Mother's Day, for offering two undercover policemen $5,000 and a handgun to kill his mother, Janice Wooton. Police had been tipped off that Wooton was seeking to have her murdered.
Wooton was being held in Perry County jail, charged with criminal conspiracy to commit murder, two counts of fraud related to the insurance policy, and carrying a concealed weapon.
